title: The Appointment That Needed More Time
title_ja: 時間が必要だった診察
fact_notes: 架空の教材例・思考実験。実在の調査、統計、法令、医療制度、実証結果ではない。登録台帳は制作来歴確認用。

sentences.en: In a fictional clinic, a manager introduces a schedule that gives each consultation the same amount of time.
sentences.ja: 架空の診療所で管理者は各診察に同じ時間を与える日程を導入する。

sentences.en: The arrangement is intended to reduce uncertainty for visitors and make the working day easier to organize.
sentences.ja: 仕組みは来院者の不確実性を減らし勤務日を調整しやすくする目的だ。

sentences.en: After a trial, the manager notices that some appointments finish early while others regularly take longer than expected.
sentences.ja: 試行後、一部は早く終わるが他は定期的に予想より長くなると気づく。

sentences.en: She initially considers asking every member of staff to follow the timetable more strictly.
sentences.ja: 当初全職員により厳格な時間表遵守を求めることを考える。

sentences.en: A staff member suggests examining why consultations vary in length before treating the differences as evidence of poor performance.
sentences.ja: 差を成績不良の証拠と扱う前に診察時間が異なる理由を調べる提案を職員がする。

sentences.en: Some fictional visitors have a simple question, whereas others need additional explanations or assistance with communication.
sentences.ja: 架空の来院者には簡単な質問の者もいれば追加説明や意思疎通支援が必要な者もいる。

sentences.en: The manager recognizes that identical appointments may impose very different demands on the people involved.
sentences.ja: 同一の予約枠でも関係者への要求は大きく異なり得ると認識する。

sentences.en: She therefore distinguishes the efficiency of a scheduling system from the quality of the interaction that it is intended to support.
sentences.ja: そこで日程管理の効率とそれが支える目的のやり取りの質を区別する。

sentences.en: The clinic considers a provisional arrangement that includes some longer appointments and a small amount of time reserved for unexpected difficulties.
sentences.ja: 一部長い予約枠と予期しない困難用の少しの予備時間を含む暫定案を検討する。

sentences.en: Staff members discuss how to identify situations that might require additional time without demanding unnecessary personal information from every visitor.
sentences.ja: 全員に不要な個人情報を求めず追加時間が必要な状況を特定する方法を議論する。

sentences.en: They also examine whether changes to written instructions could reduce the time spent resolving avoidable misunderstandings.
sentences.ja: 文書指示の変更で避けられる誤解の解消時間を減らせるかも調べる。

sentences.en: These possibilities address distinct parts of the problem rather than assuming that one longer appointment would resolve every difficulty.
sentences.ja: これらの案は一つの長い枠で全困難を解決すると想定せず問題の異なる部分に対処する。

sentences.en: During a hypothetical evaluation, the staff compare waiting times, the frequency of delayed appointments, and the practical difficulties encountered by visitors.
sentences.ja: 仮想評価で職員は待ち時間、予約遅延頻度、来院者が直面した実務的困難を比較する。

sentences.en: They recognize that reducing average waiting time could remain an important goal even if other aspects of the service also deserve attention.
sentences.ja: 他の側面にも注意が値しても平均待ち時間削減は重要な目標であり続け得ると認識する。

sentences.en: The manager avoids claiming that a particular scheduling arrangement guarantees better clinical outcomes for actual patients.
sentences.ja: 特定の日程が実患者のより良い臨床結果を保証すると主張しない。

sentences.en: The imagined case is intended only to illustrate why a single operational measure may not capture the entire purpose of a service.
sentences.ja: 仮想事例は単一運用尺度がサービス目的全体を捉えない理由の例示のみを目的とする。

sentences.en: A predictable schedule can help an organization use limited resources effectively.
sentences.ja: 予測可能な日程は組織が限られた資源を効果的に使う助けとなる。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, a system that assumes every interaction is identical may conceal meaningful differences in the needs of its users.
sentences.ja: それでも全やり取りが同一と想定する仕組みは利用者の必要の重要な差を隠し得る。

sentences.en: The challenge is to preserve useful predictability while recognizing circumstances that justify a different allocation of time.
sentences.ja: 課題は異なる時間配分を正当化する事情を認識しつつ有益な予測可能性を維持することだ。

sentences.en: For the fictional clinic, efficiency becomes a question about how time supports the intended service rather than simply how closely every appointment matches the timetable.
sentences.ja: 架空診療所にとって効率は全予約が時間表にどれほど一致するかだけでなく時間が意図したサービスをどう支えるかの問いになる。

vocabulary.definition: in a way closely following rules

questions.prompt: What does the initial schedule provide?
options: The same time for every consultation.
Some appointments took longer while others ended early.
Every appointment ended at the exact same time.

questions.prompt: Why does a staff member question the interpretation of delays?

options: Scheduling efficiency and quality of interaction.
All visitors need the same help.

questions.prompt: What measures are compared in the evaluation?
options: Waiting times, delays and practical difficulties.

questions.prompt: Why is the fictional case limited?
options: It establishes an actual clinic's performance.
It cannot demonstrate real clinical outcome improvements.
questions.explanation_ja: 実際の結果は示さない。

options: Every consultation must last exactly the same time.
Scheduling should balance efficient use of time with differences in users' needs.
Waiting time alone proves service quality.

grammar.focus: before treating the differences as evidence

paraphrases.source: After a trial, the manager notices that some appointments finish early while others regularly take longer than expected.
A staff member suggests examining why consultations vary in length before treating the differences as evidence of poor performance.
paraphrases.rewrite: A staff member asks why appointments differ before judging performance.

paraphrases.source: Staff members discuss how to identify situations that might require additional time without demanding unnecessary personal information from every visitor.
paraphrases.rewrite: Staff seek a way to estimate time needs without collecting needless personal details.

paraphrases.source: The challenge is to preserve useful predictability while recognizing circumstances that justify a different allocation of time.
paraphrases.rewrite: Useful predictability should coexist with flexibility for justified differences.
